content.value_statement: Teams often choose databases, schemas, and indexes from habit instead of context. This skill guides practical database, ORM, schema, indexing, and migration decisions.
actual_capabilities: Compares PostgreSQL, Neon, Turso, SQLite, PlanetScale, and CockroachDB for common application contexts.
Helps choose between Drizzle, Prisma, Kysely, raw SQL, and SQLAlchemy based on deployment needs.
Explains normalization, primary keys, timestamps, relationships, and foreign key delete behavior.
Guides index choices for filters, joins, ordering, unique constraints, JSONB, full-text, and vector search.
Outlines query optimization priorities, including N+1 fixes, explain plans, joins, limits, and caching.
Describes safer migration patterns for adding, removing, renaming, indexing, and backfilling data.
limitations: Does not replace production database review by an experienced engineer.
Does not benchmark a live workload or inspect real query plans automatically.
Focuses on relational and SQL-oriented systems, with limited NoSQL coverage.
Includes a Prisma schema validator script, but it provides warnings rather than complete validation.

use_cases.title: Choose a Database Stack
use_cases.description: Compare database and ORM options for a new product based on deployment, scale, and query complexity.

use_cases.title: Review a Schema Design
use_cases.description: Check table relationships, primary keys, timestamps, normalization choices, and delete behavior before implementation.

use_cases.title: Plan Performance Work
use_cases.description: Identify likely indexing, N+1 query, pagination, and caching improvements before deeper profiling.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Database
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a database for my app. Ask about deployment, data model, query complexity, scale, and operational constraints before recommending options.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature idea and propose a relational schema. Explain tables, relationships, primary keys, timestamps, indexes, and normalization trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Query Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this query workflow for N+1 problems, missing indexes, overfetching, pagination issues, and caching opportunities. Prioritize fixes by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a zero-downtime migration plan for this schema change. Include rollout steps, backfill strategy, validation checks, rollback plan, and deployment order.

output_examples.input: I need a database for a simple SaaS product with relational data and serverless hosting.
output_examples.output: A short comparison of Neon, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and SQLite with a recommended choice and trade-offs.

output_examples.input: Review my order, customer, and invoice tables before I build migrations.
output_examples.output: A schema review covering relationships, primary keys, timestamps, foreign keys, and index candidates.

output_examples.input: My dashboard loads slowly because each row fetches related data separately.
output_examples.output: A performance plan that identifies the N+1 pattern and recommends joins, eager loading, batching, and targeted indexes.

best_practices: Start with deployment context, query patterns, and operational limits before choosing a database.
Design schemas around clear relationships, stable identifiers, timestamps, and planned indexes.
Test migrations on realistic data and deploy risky changes in multiple reversible steps.
anti_patterns: Defaulting to PostgreSQL, Prisma, or any single tool without checking requirements.
Adding many indexes without considering write cost, cardinality, and actual query patterns.
Making breaking schema changes in one deployment without backfill or rollback planning.

faq.question: Does this skill write database migrations?
faq.answer: It can guide migration planning and schema decisions, but users should review generated migrations before production use.

faq.question: Which databases does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers PostgreSQL, Neon, Turso, SQLite, PlanetScale, CockroachDB, and related relational database trade-offs.

faq.question: Can it help choose an ORM?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares Drizzle, Prisma, Kysely, raw SQL, and SQLAlchemy based on deployment and developer experience needs.

faq.question: Does it optimize live databases automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides reasoning, checklists, and priorities. Users still need real metrics and query plans.

faq.question: Is this useful for serverless databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Neon, Turso, edge deployment, scale-to-zero behavior, and serverless migration concerns.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
